request: Source ticket: MAG-18 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-18/adding-status-to-manual-records. Tier 1 of roadmap RM33-manual-record-status, module charging, implementing roadmap decisions D1-D8: add status (IN_PROGRESS/DONE), energy_source (USER/ESTIMATED) and odometer_km columns to manual_charge_entries; drop NOT NULL on energy_added_kwh; add the declarative RequiredFieldsFor status-conditional validation; add the packCapacityKWh seam and derive energy on write when the user leaves it blank.

decisions.decision: Database design gate APPROVED: 3 added columns, energy_added_kwh NOT NULL dropped, no indexes, inferred_capacity_kwh_calc untouched
decisions.why: User reviewed the full DDL, rationale and index plan at the Step 3 gate and confirmed.

decisions.decision: status='DONE' requires BOTH ended_at and end_battery_pct
decisions.why: Resolves the worker's gap: the skip set only defined IN_PROGRESS. Tightens ended_at, optional today.

decisions.decision: The EnergyAddedKWh *float64 gateway compile break is fixed inside tier 1 via mechanical task L1
decisions.why: Tier 1 alone would leave go build red repo-wide, making its reviewer gate unenforceable.

decisions.decision: Unit and integration tests are INCLUDED
decisions.why: Overrides the owner's standing no-tests default; the module already has DB-backed tests on this table.

decisions.decision: Defer the Step 5.7 suite ask to the end of wave 3 rather than after waves 1 and 2
decisions.why: This change's tests are authored in wave 3; running the suite before they exist verifies nothing new and costs the owner two round-trips.

decisions.decision: Append task L1b: the same mechanical *float64 fix in internal/analytics, which design.md D11 and task L1 both omit
decisions.why: analytics/reader.go:114 sums Entry.EnergyAddedKWh; gateway imports analytics, so L1 alone cannot make go build green. Verified by the leader, not just reported.

decisions.decision: sumManualKWh skips nil energy rather than counting it as a known zero; no efficiency-semantics change in this tier
decisions.why: Mirrors the s.EnergyKWh nil-guard two lines above and keeps L1b mechanical. Whether unknown-energy entries should distort efficiency is a separate change.
